verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud marketplace that handles customer data, so a policy or control keeping that data out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, training opt-out, or no-training commitment. Nearby items (Secure Cloud datacenter certification, exclusive GPU access, SSH key-only auth) cover different security features and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
